svg.text: Hey, I'm Arnabh - a 19-year-old developer and designer from Lucknow. I'm the founder of Hubrave, a
tech-driven digital agency, and I'm studying BCA (Data Science & AI) at SRMU.
I build web products end to end - React / Next.js frontends, Supabase and Node backends - and AI
automations for real businesses, like voice call assistants and lead-response systems. I design in
Figma before I write code. My team Sentinels got selected in Smart India Hackathon 2026.
Build products people actually use and pay for, and grow Hubrave into a company that matters - not
Making music as Visxh, playing with my band Kaaya, gaming, and running BGMI scrim tournaments.
